notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP fetch only - curl_cffi impersonate='chrome124' against www.elcorteingles.es. robots.txt (fetched via curl_cffi; plain curl was Akamai-blocked) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow and no blanket User-agent:*/Disallow:/, so tier (a) is permitted; Claude-in-Chrome was never needed. No __NEXT_DATA__/__NUXT__ blob; site is server-rendered PLP HTML (Moonshine/Firefly platform) with a reliable h1 span 'plp_title_h1__total' count and, for one zero-result page, an embedded total_products JSON field - both parsed with regex, no manual counting. TREE: El Corte Ingles is a huge general-merchandise department store; scoped to the Home department only. Top textile hub is /textil-hogar-y-descanso/hogar/ which fans out to /hogar/ropa-de-cama/ (Bed Linen, 709 total - hub, not recorded per parent-URL rule), /hogar/nordicos/ (Duvet fill inserts), /hogar/toppers/, /hogar/proteccion-descanso/, /hogar/textil-bano/, /hogar/textil-decoracion/, /hogar/textil-mesa-y-cocina/ - each page's own left-nav sub-category strip was crawled to enumerate leaves. Storage lives under /hogar/ordenacion/ (Storage & Organization) plus a small set of explicit storage items surfaced from the general /hogar/bano/ (Bathroom) department index. QTY: every leaf's qty is the exact number in the rendered h1 'X productos' header (evidence string per row); one leaf (Food Storage Containers) showed 0 via an embedded total_products:0/total_pages:0 JSON field, recorded as qty 0 per storage.md Sec.39, not skipped. Every leaf's canonical <link> tag was checked against the requested slug to catch the 'bad slug silently serves parent's total' trap (STEP1 rule 2) - caught and dropped /hogar/nordicos/nordicos-algodon-organico/ (canonical redirects to parent /hogar/nordicos/) and /hogar/ordenacion/bolsas-de-compra/ and /hogar/ordenacion/organizacion-de-cocina/ (both canonicalize to the /hogar/ordenacion/ hub). EXCLUDED and why: sleep-system verticals (Almohadas/pillows, Colchones/mattresses, Bases/Somieres/Canapes/bed bases, Descanso hub) - primary product type is a sleep support product, not fabric home furnishing, and not Furniture either; left in neither array. Merceria (wool skeins, sewing scissors/box) - craft/haberdashery notions, not home furnishing textile. Ropa-de-cama/Lisos and premium-and-luxury-collections and toallas/toallas-lisas - color/tier facets cutting across multiple product types rather than a distinct product-type subcategory (and 'collections' naming triggers rule 27); skipped to avoid facet-inflation. Bolsas-de-playa (beach bags) and papeles-pintados (wallpaper) - excluded per textile boundary rules. On the Storage side: carros-de-compra (grocery shopping trolleys), cubos-de-basura/papeleras-de-bano (trash cans/bins), bolsas-de-basura-y-accesorios/bolsas-reutilizables (trash/shopping bags), tablas-de-planchar/fundas-para-tablas-de-plancha/accesorios-de-lavado-y-planchado (ironing boards, ironing-board covers, clothes pegs/wash bags), tendederos (drying racks), limpieza-en-el-hogar (mops/dusters/glass cleaner - cleaning tools, not storage), and parabanes (freestanding room-divider/dressing screens - furniture-like) were all excluded as non-storage per storage.md Secs.11/19/21/30. /orden-en-el-armario/hogar/ordenacion/ and /orden-en-el-bano/hogar/ are themed micro-site landing pages that re-list the same underlying Ordenacion/Bano categories under a slightly different, non-matching product count (e.g. Cajas 40 direct vs 36 via the armario theme page) rather than a genuinely distinct catalog node - treated as duplicate/thematic presentations of already-captured categories and skipped per the duplicate-prevention rule. Servilletas (Napkins, qty 94) is flagged LOW confidence and MANUAL REVIEW because the site bundles paper napkins with cloth/cotton/linen napkins under one count with no material sub-filter, so the 94 total is not purely textile. Two Storage rows (Bathroom Shelves, Towel Racks) and one Textile row (Roller Blinds/Estores, mixed bamboo-jute-screen fabrics) are MEDIUM confidence as fixture-adjacent but explicitly rule-listed items.
